verdict.rationale: A community user reports that their team used Asana itself for remote team communication instead of Slack. The app directory also references comments living inside Asana, which suggests some in-tool discussion surface. The Slack and Microsoft Teams integrations point to external chat apps and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an in-app chat or messaging feature, real-time conversation capability (rather than task comments), and independent hands-on corroboration of in-tool team chat.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can chat with my team directly inside the same tool I plan work in

citations.quote: my team always used it for remote team communication and project management. We never saw the need for apps like Slack or Basecamp
trackable tasks and comments in Asana
